articles.title: There's an election next month: State of Crypto
articles.summary: Congress is gone from Washington for the final pre-election recess, and it's time to take stock of what's going on ahead of November.

articles.title: Crypto poured years into new products. The next challenge is keeping users
articles.summary: Crypto firms have spent years building financial products on blockchains. Getting people to use them — and keep using them — is becoming the next challenge.

articles.title: The Clarity Act stalled. Bankers aren’t hitting the brakes yet on crypto dealmaking
articles.summary: Crypto M&A has hit record levels, but the Clarity Act’s Senate setback leaves dealmakers weighing how much regulatory uncertainty still matters.
